about.text: Stretch-curd cheeses are those prepared using the pasta filata technique. They are also known as pulled-curd and plastic-curd cheeses. The cheeses manufactured from this technique undergo a plasticising and kneading treatment of the fresh curd in hot water, which gives them fibrous structures.

how.text: Once acid has built up, the curd becomes plastic in hot water. It can then be kneaded and stretched into a fibrous, elastic paste.

steps.note: The hazelnut-size grains rest until the whey has 0.7–0.8 % lactic acid.
Curd kneaded and stretched in the hot water.
Dry-salted about 2 h, or the stretching water is salted instead.
